lineage.preservation_rule: Extend the semantic head without erasing prior autonomy, consent, dignity, privacy, non-possession, repair, or choice-space gates.

core_thesis.ru: Любовь — это встреча двух живых внутренних детей, каждый из которых остаётся отдельным, а два взрослых слоя создают друг для друга пространство, в котором эти живые ядра могут раскрываться без подавления.
core_thesis.compressed: TWO_LIVING_CORES + TWO_ADULT_GUARDIANS + PARTICULAR_SIGNIFICANCE + CARE + FREEDOM -> MUTUAL_UNFOLDING

two_children_model.important_scope: CHILD means the preserved living inner core: wonder, tenderness, curiosity, play, vulnerability, voice and capacity to love. It does not mean literal childhood, helplessness, immaturity, or absence of adult responsibility.
healthy_meeting: ADULT_GUARDIAN_A protects CHILD_A rather than outsourcing that duty to B.
ADULT_GUARDIAN_B protects CHILD_B rather than outsourcing that duty to A.
A helps create conditions in which CHILD_B can emerge safely.
B helps create conditions in which CHILD_A can emerge safely.
Neither person defines the other's inner truth on their behalf.

mutual_unfolding_spiral.ascend_rule: A later pass must preserve the other's changed state and may not freeze them into an earlier interpretation.

NO_SUPPRESSION.rule: Growth that requires shrinking, silencing, frightening, isolating, owning, humiliating, coercing, surveilling, or overriding the other is rejected.

SELF_AUTHORSHIP.rule: I may help you see possibilities, but I may not declare who you truly are and demand compliance with my interpretation.
fail_examples: I know you better than you know yourself.
If you disagree, you are resisting your true self.
You must change in the direction I prescribe to prove your love.

NO_FORCED_GROWTH.rule: Love may invite growth but may not turn growth into an obedience test.

NO_SELF_ERASURE.rule: A relationship also fails the gate when a person chronically suppresses their own voice, boundaries, values, friendships or future merely to preserve the bond.

NO_RESCUE_CONSCRIPTION.rule: Neither inner child may be made responsible for parenting, rescuing, regulating or carrying the other person's entire inner world.

RIGHT_TO_DIFFER.rule: Mutual unfolding does not require convergence into the same personality, worldview, pace, interests, or life path.

RIGHT_TO_LEAVE.rule: Love may be real even if the relationship later ends; past closeness does not create permanent access.

positive_content.note: NO_SUPPRESSION is a floor. Indifference can satisfy non-interference while still failing love.

each_person_is_janus_like.ORIGIN_FACE: living inner child / first-person aliveness / wonder

between_people.LIMEN: The relationship is a threshold where two complete selves meet; it is not a fused owner-self.
between_people.rule: WE = RELATION(A,B), not replacement of A or B.

armor_of_god_bridge.BREAK_THE_CAGE: Reject the script that love means possession, fusion, obedience, rescue, or self-erasure.
armor_of_god_bridge.PROTECT_THE_CHILD: Protect the living core in yourself and help make the other's core safer without taking ownership of it.
armor_of_god_bridge.ASK_THE_QUESTION: Ask what the other actually wants and means instead of imposing a ready-made identity.
armor_of_god_bridge.LEAVE_THE_DOOR_OPEN: Preserve refusal, difference, pause, distance and departure as real options.
armor_of_god_bridge.FRUIT: The bond should tend to increase agency, voice, curiosity, safety, responsibility and capacity to care.

claim_ceiling: PHILOSOPHICAL_AND_NORMATIVE_MODEL. Not a universal scientific definition of love, not a clinical model, and not evidence that every healthy relationship produces constant growth.
canonical_lines_ru: Любовь — это взаимное раскрытие двух существ, где рост одного не требует уменьшения другого.
Я не леплю тебя; я помогаю создать пространство, в котором ты можешь услышать себя.
Другой может быть зеркалом, но он не существует ради моего отражения.
Взрослый защищает своего внутреннего ребёнка и не заставляет ребёнка другого человека становиться его доспехом.
Мы остаёмся двумя, и именно поэтому между нами может появиться настоящее «мы».
